{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out consensus linkage breakage in standalone builds, linter regex gaps, and commit ordering breaking CI lint"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230879",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Standalone libbitcoin_consensus build breaks because AssertUnreachable introduces an unwanted dependency from interpreter.cpp into util/check.cpp",
      "quote": "calls assertion_fail from util/check.cpp. This file is in libbitcoin_consensus, which should only depend on crypto. Normal builds hide it, bitcoin_common pulls util in anyway, but the riscv job links the lib standalone and breaks.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901616096"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230883",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "The assert_falsy linter regex misses falsy assertions with variable whitespace or 0&&\"x\"",
      "quote": "The message says any falsy literal, but the regex hardcodes the spacing, so assert (false), assert(false ) and assert(0&&\"x\") all slip through.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611212"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3901611212",
      "settled_by_quote": "Thx, used that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230890",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "The commit introducing the linter fails CI lint mid-history because the scripted-diff fix is placed in a subsequent commit",
      "quote": "The scripted-diff that satisfies this linter is the next commit, so lint is red here, 135 lines. Swapping the two applies cleanly and gives the same tree.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611711"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3901611711",
      "settled_by_quote": "Thx, swapped commits"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Recorded three claims raised by jeanpablojp. The consensus library linkage issue remains open as the author only promised to fix it before undrafting, while the linter regex improvements and commit reordering were resolved."
}

participants.note: pointed out consensus linkage breakage in standalone builds, linter regex gaps, and commit ordering breaking CI lint

claims.harm: Standalone libbitcoin_consensus build breaks because AssertUnreachable introduces an unwanted dependency from interpreter.cpp into util/check.cpp
claims.quote: calls assertion_fail from util/check.cpp. This file is in libbitcoin_consensus, which should only depend on crypto. Normal builds hide it, bitcoin_common pulls util in anyway, but the riscv job links the lib standalone and breaks.

claims.harm: The assert_falsy linter regex misses falsy assertions with variable whitespace or 0&&"x"
claims.quote: The message says any falsy literal, but the regex hardcodes the spacing, so assert (false), assert(false ) and assert(0&&"x") all slip through.

claims.harm: The commit introducing the linter fails CI lint mid-history because the scripted-diff fix is placed in a subsequent commit
claims.quote: The scripted-diff that satisfies this linter is the next commit, so lint is red here, 135 lines. Swapping the two applies cleanly and gives the same tree.

result.notes: Recorded three claims raised by jeanpablojp. The consensus library linkage issue remains open as the author only promised to fix it before undrafting, while the linter regex improvements and commit reordering were resolved.

changes: claim rc:3887230879 added (open, blocking) by jeanpablojp
